title: Clef-flash Decisions
description: Answer classification, yes/no probability and ordinal scoring questions about text, JSON or images with Cloudflare's Clef-flash, on the SystemOne request format. Weights and model code are pinned; outputs are gated against an fp32 reference within measured bf16 tolerance (verified on H100, A40 and L40S).

input.name: Dtype
input.description: bfloat16 is the serving dtype and matches fixtures/clef-flash/bfloat16 exactly. float32 matches the truth reference but needs an 80 GB GPU; this setting does not change the GPU.

input.name: Max input tokens
input.description: Requests are truncated in the state to this many tokens; a schema longer than this is rejected.

input.name: Model revision
input.description: Hugging Face commit of Cloudflare/clef-flash. The default is the revision the parity reference was produced from; changing it voids that guarantee.

input.name: Model code sha256
input.description: sha256 of the snapshot's joint_schema_model.py. The worker refuses to execute model code that does not match. Clear it only when deliberately changing MODEL_REVISION.

input.name: Attention kernel
input.description: efficient keeps attention memory linear in sequence length. math matches it to printed precision but materializes T×T and runs out of memory near 16k tokens.

input.name: Worker startup timeout (seconds)
input.description: Weights load before the worker accepts jobs. Without a network volume the first start downloads ~19 GB to container disk; with one, startup is seconds.
